routes.claim: A request derives only from one exact persisted held v2.8 observation.
routes.passCondition: A held observation exact-reloads and builds; non-held, missing, altered, or corrupt observations fail without output.
routes.primarySurface: focused runtime assertions over held and non-held persisted fixtures
routes.counterevidence: any non-held or non-exact observation produces a request

routes.claim: The Review Inbox candidate embeds the exact minimized self-digested artifact it asks a reviewer to inspect.
routes.passCondition: Candidate raw digest equals the artifact self-digest and any artifact, action, summary, or digest tamper fails exact rebuild.
routes.counterevidence: candidate digest can diverge from its embedded artifact

routes.claim: The existing ReviewService accepts the candidate and a fresh receiver process reloads the same pending item.
routes.passCondition: Initial receiver item and fresh-process reload are byte-equivalent and exactly match the request projection.
routes.primarySurface: sender item plus separate-process receiver reload tied by item id and digest
routes.counterevidence: receiver rejects, changes, loses, votes, discusses, or reclassifies the item

routes.claim: The bridge declares the host-authorized route but performs no submission, vote, review, approval, hold resolution, execution, or promotion.
routes.passCondition: Request and handoff fix all authority fields false; runtime has no ReviewService, API, network, or write call; only the synthetic compatibility harness mutates a temporary receiver root.
routes.primarySurface: source and closed-schema inspection plus denied-state assertions
routes.counterevidence: runtime imports ReviewService, writes review state, invokes the API, records a vote, resolves the hold, or grants authority

routes.claim: Public review artifacts omit paths, full v2.7 audits, input packages, votes, notes, identities, model output, and private context.
routes.passCondition: Key-aware scan finds only references, classifications, bounded decisions, and explicit negative truth fields.
routes.primarySurface: runtime artifact inspection and forbidden-key scan
routes.counterevidence: any configured path, full upstream audit, package, vote, note, identity, output, or private-context payload appears

routes.claim: The additive leaf preserves inherited Workshop behavior.
routes.passCondition: Focused, inherited, all ten AGENTS, evidence, and detached replay commands exit zero on stable inputs.
routes.counterevidence: any nonzero command or task-relevant workspace movement
routes.secondarySurface: final shared-workspace snapshot and clean detached replay
